hook: Russia and Ukraine agree on one thing
caption:
🤝 Russia and Ukraine agree a large prisoner swap in Abu Dhabi, but no ceasefire breakthrough.
🇮🇷 Rubio says no need for major combat against Iran; Iran says no talks are happening.
🏠 Spain's first general strike in 14 years, over housing. In Spain? Expect transport disruption.
📈 US prices rose 0.4% in October. A December Fed hike now looks almost certain, so US borrowing may cost more.
🌍 COP31 climate summit under way in Antalya, with 90,000+ expected.

1/5 Russia-Ukraine prisoner swap (2 days)
Abu Dhabi talks ended with a deal to swap prisoners. First talks in nine months; no ceasefire breakthrough.
📷 Wadiia (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

2/5 Rubio: no major Iran combat (G7)
Rubio: economic pressure works, so no major Iran combat. Iran says no talks with the US are happening.
📷 Frans Berkelaar (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Spain strikes over housing (14 yrs)
Spain's biggest unions called a 24-hour nationwide strike. First in 14 years, weeks before the 29 November election.
📷 Tamorlan (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

4/5 US inflation beats forecasts (+0.4%)
US prices rose 0.4% in October, above the 0.3% forecast. Markets now see a December rate hike as almost certain.
📷 Federalreserve (Public domain) via wikimedia

5/5 Climate summit hits Antalya (90,000)
The COP31 UN climate summit is under way in Antalya. The UN expects over 90,000 attendees through 20 November.
📷 Tugceeakgunn91 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia
